name: Debug Mode

gist.Cybug LOCUST: Face-down. When you equip or attach a card to one of your heroes, it is attached to Rana's hero instead. Paid for by deleting a Treasure Hunter's Backpack.
gist.Cybug LADYBUG: Face-down. When you activate an Ability, it is cancelled and a copy of any Ability on the board is knocked off. Paid for with a Magic Amethyst.
gist.Cybug ANTS: Face-down. When you damage its hero without killing it, the same damage is dealt to one of your targets. Paid for with a Future Tech Gun.
gist.Cybug RHINOCEROS: Face-down. When you place a card into an Area or support zone, that card is discarded. Paid for with an Excavator Bucket.
gist.Troop Annihilation: Reaction when one of her bugs dies: her other creatures die too and she sets that many new bugs face-down from the deck, unseen.
gist.Future Tech Gun: Equipment that mostly exists to be deleted for ANTS; returns to hand when the bug dies.
gist.Magic Amethyst: Makes you discard an Ability from a hero; also the fuel for LADYBUG.
gist.Treasure Hunter's Backpack: Free equipment from the deck; also the fuel for LOCUST.
gist.Excavator Bucket: Removes an Area each turn; also the fuel for RHINOCEROS.
gist.Bakhm, the Desert Digger: May hide trap creatures in his support zones as well, and every time any trap goes off he hits a target hard.
gist.Alleria, the Queen of Spiders: Sets a trap straight from the deck each turn, draws when her own trap fires and can pull a single hit onto a hero with a trap.
gist.Cybug BEE: Face-down. When you would search a card from your deck, she takes that card instead. Paid for with a Magnetic Glove.
gist.Cybug CENTIPEDE: Face-down. When you would draw cards by an effect, she draws the same number. Paid for with a Wheels.
gist.Cybug SCARAB: Face-down. When one of her other heroes is defeated, it stands back up on a little health. Paid for with a Golden Ankh.
gist.Magnetic Glove: Searches any card; also the fuel for BEE.
gist.Wheels: Draws three; also the fuel for CENTIPEDE.

plan: Rana never acts first. Her side of the table is face-down cards, each a Cybug waiting for one specific thing you might do: attach something, activate an Ability, search your deck, draw extra cards, deal non-lethal damage, place a card. The bug cancels or steals the play and Bakhm hits you for every trap that fires. Each Cybug is paid for by deleting a matching artifact, and Troop Annihilation refills the traps when a bug dies. It is an inventive, carefully built deck with very little proactive damage: it needs you to walk into things, it runs out of the paired artifacts over a long game, and a patient opponent who springs the traps with throwaway plays leaves her with little.

looks.early: Five or six face-down cards across Bakhm, Alleria and Mizune; nothing face-up at all.
looks.mid: A couple of tiny flipped Cybugs, fresh face-down cards replacing them, Bakhm hitting back every time something triggers.
looks.late: Fewer face-down cards than before, a deleted pile full of Guns and Amethysts, and Rana chewing her lip over what is left.

opening.tell: Every hero of hers has a face-down card, and she has not played a single card face-up.
opening.why: Each bug answers one kind of play, so spring them with things you do not mind losing before committing: attaching Gathering Storm into a hidden LOCUST hands her the Storm, and Leadership into a LADYBUG costs you the Ability, while a Magnetic Glove into a BEE hands her the card you searched.

midgame.tell: A flipped Cybug sits on her board with almost no health, and she is holding a single card ready.
midgame.why: Killing a bug lets Troop Annihilation reload a fresh set of unseen traps and hands her fuel back; her heroes, on the other hand, have no protection that works against untargeted Storm ticks and Chain Lightning.

crisis.tell: Her deleted pile holds most of her Guns, Amethysts and Backpacks; the newest face-down cards went down without her paying anything.
crisis.why: A Cybug cannot fire without its paired artifact left in hand or deck, so many of the remaining face-down cards are blanks: this is the safe moment to attach the Storm and The White Eye, and removal spent on bluffs is wasted.

endgame.tell: She has one or two traps left and is taking a long time over every decision.
endgame.why: With the traps mostly spent she has no way to win a race; clearing the last tiny bugs only risks one more Troop Annihilation.
